title: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
intro: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) interview questions cover the platform powering an increasing share of Java backend roles — the core GCP services for backend developers (Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL, Spanner, BigQuery), Pub/Sub messaging, Cloud Storage, IAM and Workload Identity, Secret Manager, Cloud Monitoring, and the deployment patterns for Spring Boot on Cloud Run vs GKE. Use this page when the job description specifies GCP — the questions are different enough from AWS that a generic cloud answer will not cut it.
